details.description: Azure AI Speech's speech-to-text service, part of Microsoft's Azure AI Foundry Tools, converts spoken audio into text using a pretrained Universal Language Model, with optional custom speech models for domain-specific accuracy. It supports real-time transcription for live audio, a fast transcription API for near-synchronous results, and asynchronous batch transcription for large volumes of prerecorded audio, across many supported languages and locales.
advantages: Offers three transcription modes (real-time, fast near-synchronous, and asynchronous batch) to match different latency needs.
Diarization can identify and separate up to 35 different speakers in a single audio recording.
Real-time multichannel transcription (preview) can transcribe up to two audio channels independently and tag results by source channel.
Custom speech lets you fine-tune the base recognition model with domain-specific vocabulary and audio conditions to improve accuracy.
Phrase lists and automatic language detection help the model better recognize domain-specific terminology and multilingual audio content.
disadvantages: Real-time multichannel transcription is still in preview.
use_cases: Healthcare dictation with custom medical vocabulary

sources.title: Speech to Text Overview - Speech Service - Foundry Tools | Microsoft Learn

notes: This catalog entry (azure/speech/azure-stt) is a generic name for Azure's speech-to-text service rather than one named model, so the description covers the service's default Universal Language Model and capabilities rather than a single dated model. The overview page does not state a total language/locale count, so no language list or count is given.
